items.headline: Low Water Advisory issued November 26 at 6:47AM CST until November 26 at 7:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...Abnormally low water levels.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM CST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Below normal water levels will result in hazardous
navigating conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels up to 1 foot below mean lower
low water are expected during low tide.
items.instruction:
Mariners should navigate shallow waters with extreme caution due
to below normal water levels.
